name: GeoCities Homepage
summary: A personal page with a tiled star or marble background, rainbow rules, animated GIFs, a visitor counter, a guestbook and an under-construction sign. Free web hosts such as GeoCities made it common.

philosophy.core_thesis: Every person owns a page, and the page shows what its owner loves, with no care for taste.
design_principles: Tile a small background image (32px to 128px) of stars, marble or clouds over the full page.
Set body text in a bright colour on a dark ground, for example yellow (#FFFF00) on navy (#000080).
Separate sections with a rainbow rule or a GIF line 4px to 8px high.
Place 3 to 6 animated GIFs on the page: a spinning mail box, a flame, a waving flag, a 'NEW!' tag.
Add a visitor counter of 6 digits, a guestbook link and a sign 'Under construction' at the top.
Centre the content in one column of 600px to 640px and set links in a bright colour on a dark ground.
Put a marquee line at the top that scrolls text at about 60px per second.
anti_patterns: Clean white space and a limited palette
Matched type scale with one family
Hidden counters and no personal items

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred column of 600px to 640px or a table with a left menu of 150px; no real grid, items stack at random sizes.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the page stays empty; the gap between items is 8px to 16px, usually from line breaks.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred headings and text; images float left or right at 8px offsets; a marquee runs across the top.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px radius; image buttons of 88px by 31px; tables with 2px outset borders.

font_pairings.note: Comic Neue is an open look-alike of Comic Sans MS, the usual homepage face.
A pixel face for headings and counters.
A loud comic display with a default serif text.

hierarchy_rules: Use sizes 14px, 18px and 32px; add a 48px title.
Change colour for each section heading: yellow, lime, cyan and pink.
Use bold for all headings and underline for links.
Use one colour for text on each page.

color.palette_structure: Pure bright web colours on a dark or tiled ground; 5 to 8 hues on one page with no order.
color.contrast_rules: Yellow on navy is 12:1; lime on navy is 11:1; pink on navy is 5:1 and stays for headings of 24px or more.
color.surface_treatment: A tiled pattern image on the page and flat colour on tables; no soft gradients.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source; buttons use a 2px outset bevel; text may carry a 2px black drop shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A pinboard of GIFs: pixel images with hard edges and limited palettes (256 colours).
materiality.border_rules: A 2px outset border on tables and buttons; 1px dotted lines around images.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a hard 2px shadow in black on headings.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Pixel GIFs at 32px: envelope, home, mailbox, flame, globe and 'NEW!' stars, with dithered edges.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Clip art, tiled backgrounds, animated GIF mascots, banners of 468px by 60px and 88px by 31px badges.

motion.transition_physics: Elements loop at 4 to 12 frames per second: spinning icons, flames and a marquee at 60px per second; pages cut with no easing.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover turns a link from lime to pink and shows a status-bar text; a visited link becomes purple (#800080).

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the warmth, the clutter and the sincerity of a personal page.

use_cases: nostalgic fan pages and personal sites
avoid_when: The page needs trust, safety or a clear task flow.
The brand needs a calm, premium tone.

modifiers.how: Replace the loud ground with white, a blue header band and a table of link lists.
Add a profile photo, a top friends grid and a music player.
Remove the GIFs and keep the raw default HTML.

pack.why: Pixel icons match the 32px GIFs of a homepage.

ground.why: The ground is a tiled background with scattered coloured marks, like a stars-and-marble tile.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none border-2 border-white bg-[#FF00FF] px-3 py-1 text-sm font-bold text-black hover:bg-[#00FFFF]
